title: Move Credit by Length of a Company Date Move — Installation Jobs
content:
**Move credit by length of the move — company reschedules on Installation Jobs**

What a company reschedule did with the crew date of an **Installation Jobs** record decides how the move credit is worked out. The reschedule considered is the most recent crew date Ridgeline itself moved or released on the job — the most recent reschedule recorded as caused by the company — with the crew date it moved and its new crew date, if any.

| What the company reschedule did | Move credit |
|---|---|
| moved the crew date more than 14 days later | $60.00 for every started week of the move: the days moved divided by 7 and rounded up |
| released the crew date with no new date | the method's company reschedule credit plus $25.00 for rebooking |
| moved the crew date by 14 days or fewer | the method's company reschedule credit |

The days moved are the calendar days from the crew date moved to the new crew date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, method credit figure 100.00)

| Days moved | Started weeks | Move credit |
|---|---|---|
| 14 | — | 100.00 |
| 15 | 15 divided by 7 is 2.14, rounded up to 3 | 3 times 60.00, that is 180.00 |
| 21 | 3 | 180.00 |
| 22 | 22 divided by 7 is 3.14, rounded up to 4 | 240.00 |
| released, no new date | — | 100.00 plus 25.00, that is 125.00 |
